FACT_ID: sec01-R01 | anchor: A01
An Alcohol Restricted Driver faces a zero-alcohol bar after past alcohol offenses, while Extreme DUI is a present offense tier set by high alcohol readings or drug combinations [A01].
Why it matters: group alcohol-statuses; difficulty medium; prereq none; confusables sec01-F01, sec01-F13 [A01].
Source: [A01 -> src:rdmv-ut-class-d:utah-dld:handbook:pdf-0011]

FACT_ID: sec01-R02 | anchor: A01
Cancellation ends a license issued wrongly or without consent, while denied means the driving privilege itself has been withdrawn [A01].
Why it matters: group license-actions; difficulty high; prereq none; confusables sec01-F05, sec01-F08 [A01].
Source: [A01 -> src:rdmv-ut-class-d:utah-dld:handbook:pdf-0011]

FACT_ID: sec01-R03 | anchor: A01
Careless driving has two independent triggers: repeated moving violations in one continuous drive, or one moving violation plus unrelated in-vehicle distraction [A01].
Why it matters: group violations; difficulty medium; prereq none; confusables sec01-F06 [A01].
Source: [A01 -> src:rdmv-ut-class-d:utah-dld:handbook:pdf-0011]

FACT_ID: sec01-R04 | anchor: A01
Commercial licensing turns on weight, capacity, or cargo: 26,001-plus pounds, 16-plus passengers, hazmat, doubles or triples, tankers, or school buses [A01].
Why it matters: group license-classes; difficulty high; prereq none; confusables sec01-F07 [A01].
Source: [A01 -> src:rdmv-ut-class-d:utah-dld:handbook:pdf-0011]

FACT_ID: sec01-R05 | anchor: A02
An Interlock Restricted Driver must drive with an installed interlock, an interdicted person may not be furnished alcohol at all, and the Ignition Interlock Device is the breath-test hardware itself [A02].
Why it matters: group alcohol-statuses; difficulty high; prereq none; confusables sec01-F19, sec01-F18, sec01-F17 [A02].
Source: [A02 -> src:rdmv-ut-class-d:utah-dld:handbook:pdf-0012]

FACT_ID: sec01-R06 | anchor: A02
A license is the privilege, a license certificate is the proving document, and the operator is the person in physical control [A02].
Why it matters: group license-basics; difficulty low; prereq none; confusables sec01-F20, sec01-F21, sec01-F30 [A02].
Source: [A02 -> src:rdmv-ut-class-d:utah-dld:handbook:pdf-0012]

FACT_ID: sec01-R07 | anchor: A02
Limited-term and non-domiciled documents share one test: lawful presence proved, yet the holder is no citizen, national, or permanent resident [A02].
Why it matters: group identity-documents; difficulty medium; prereq none; confusables sec01-F22, sec01-F23, sec01-F29 [A02].
Source: [A02 -> src:rdmv-ut-class-d:utah-dld:handbook:pdf-0012]

FACT_ID: sec01-R08 | anchor: A02
Every motorcycle is a motor vehicle, but motorcycles exclude farm tractors while motor vehicles exclude wheelchairs, assistive devices, and human-powered vehicles [A02].
Why it matters: group vehicle-classes; difficulty high; prereq none; confusables sec01-F27, sec01-F28 [A02].
Source: [A02 -> src:rdmv-ut-class-d:utah-dld:handbook:pdf-0012]

FACT_ID: sec01-R09 | anchor: A02
The mobility vehicle is the disability vehicle meeting Division specs, while the permit is the Division authority with conditions for driving it on public highways [A02].
Why it matters: group disability-mobility; difficulty medium; prereq none; confusables sec01-F25, sec01-F26 [A02].
Source: [A02 -> src:rdmv-ut-class-d:utah-dld:handbook:pdf-0012]

FACT_ID: sec01-R10 | anchor: A02
Low-speed status caps speed at 25 and seats at four including the driver, and never covers golf carts or off-highway vehicles [A02].
Why it matters: group vehicle-classes; difficulty low; prereq none; confusables sec01-F24 [A02].
Source: [A02 -> src:rdmv-ut-class-d:utah-dld:handbook:pdf-0012]

FACT_ID: sec01-R11 | anchor: A03
Suspension withdraws driving privilege temporarily, while revocation ends it outright [A03].
Why it matters: group license-actions; difficulty low; prereq none; confusables sec01-F42, sec01-F38 [A03].
Source: [A03 -> src:rdmv-ut-class-d:utah-dld:handbook:pdf-0013]

FACT_ID: sec01-R12 | anchor: A03
Regular CDL, identification, and license-certificate documents share one test: the holder is a citizen, national, or permanent resident [A03].
Why it matters: group identity-documents; difficulty low; prereq none; confusables sec01-F35, sec01-F36, sec01-F37 [A03].
Source: [A03 -> src:rdmv-ut-class-d:utah-dld:handbook:pdf-0013]

FACT_ID: sec01-R13 | anchor: A03
Pedestrian vehicles and personal motorized mobility devices both serve limited mobility, but only the pedestrian vehicle carries the width, engine, and speed caps [A03].
Why it matters: group disability-mobility; difficulty medium; prereq none; confusables sec01-F31, sec01-F32 [A03].
Source: [A03 -> src:rdmv-ut-class-d:utah-dld:handbook:pdf-0013]

FACT_ID: sec01-R14 | anchor: A03
Provisional licenses turn on driver age under 21, while temporary licenses turn on a six-month clock and exclude Driving Privilege Card holders [A03].
Why it matters: group license-classes; difficulty medium; prereq none; confusables sec01-F34, sec01-F44 [A03].
Source: [A03 -> src:rdmv-ut-class-d:utah-dld:handbook:pdf-0013]
